title: Microsoft Purview DSPM: Copilot readiness and data explorer
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap targets, existing DSPM navigation and published background requirements are supported, and searches confirmed the narrowly stated documentation gaps. Remove the suggestion that the new readiness figures become stale after inactivity: Microsoft documents a pause in current DSPM processing, but not that behaviour for the planned readiness view.

claims.quote: We’re introducing the new readiness for Microsoft Copilot and data explorer experiences in Microsoft Purview Data Security Posture Management (DSPM).

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: Microsoft pauses current DSPM background processing that refreshes Microsoft 365 data after more than 60 days without tenant access.
claims.quote: Microsoft pauses the background processing that refreshes Microsoft 365 data in Data Security Posture Management when a tenant hasn't accessed the solution for more than 60 days.

claims.claim: The inactivity pause means readiness figures can be stale in a tenant where nobody visits.
claims.quote: Searched: DSPM readiness 60 days; readiness for Microsoft Copilot. Read DSPM considerations and learn-about. Current documentation says paused tenants see no Microsoft 365 information in certain existing views, not that the planned readiness figures remain visible but stale.
claims.fix: Remove ', so readiness figures can be stale in a tenant where nobody visits' from the Change & support bullet. Retain the preceding sentence about the documented pause in DSPM Microsoft 365 background refresh.
